main_text.p: In summâ ac profulâ hilaritate cor solet salire: itidemque in pavore.
Viri fortes, strenui in honoribus saepè negliguntur ob malos saeculi mores. Ita virtuti omnis adimitur quandoq; honos.
Alii ob virtutem, gloriam assequuntur immortalem: alij ob malefacta.
Ad utramq; rationem alludit noster Capt. 3. f. v. 31. 32.
Qui ex imis sordibus ad summas dignitates evehuntur; lumbrici appellantur.
Alexander Magnus & Agathocles, ob res maximas gloriam immortalem sunt consecuti.
Virgo mala est, quæ sapit præter quàm placet parentibus.
Parentes verberare piaculare nefas: abominabile prorsus occidere.

page.notes: Ornament (ᴥ-like printer's flourish) between the text and the catchword is not transcribed as text. The running head and page number are set in small capitals and spaced type. Some marginal reference marks are faint; no margin notes were legible on this scan.
